proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 68 prints /pəṭ.ka/ “a piece of cloth worn round a waist by woman.” Turner7700 gives Hindi paṭkā “loincloth” and Pali paṭṭaka “girdle”; the established -kk- extension node 7700-2 captures the -ṭk- cloth form, while the source specifies the wearer.
